name: The Butchery
desc:
One night after driving down the wrong road deep in the Cottonwood Mountains, you are taken inside an old farmhouse home to two strange brothers.



UPDATES:
30/05/2026 - Part 4 and 5 released

FOR THE BEST EXPERIENCE:
- If you are playing on a computer or laptop it is recommended to use a mouse
- Lower your graphics level if you are having trouble navigating dark spaces
- Turn on Reduce Motion in settings to disable camera bobbing if you are prone to motion sickness

CREDITS:
The Butchery was inspired by Resident Evil 7: Biohazard.



TAGS: Horror, Adventure, Action, Puzzle, Pig, Friendship
